series: Quacked Concierge Peak Glow Up (Mid-Mountain Rest)

rules.blocking: A blocking gate must be PASS before the next step (or the next job of the same kind) starts.
rules.approver: 'harness' = automatic QC by DuckDuckGoose; 'Travis' = explicit approval logged in STATUS.md with CEST time; 'harness + Travis' = harness check then Travis decision.
rules.default_external_actions: HOLD (never post/upload/send without explicit Travis order)
rules.check_type: code = deterministic script decides; judge = vision/LLM model decides under judge_policy; human = Travis decides (logged in STATUS with CEST time). 'assist' names the secondary check.

higgsfield.l5_note: Ep03 used 0 on finalize. A Seedance finalize/upscale pilot is drawn from L6 with a GC.06 report.

unit_prices.unit: Higgsfield app credits (ElevenLabs entries: ElevenLabs credits)

cloud_api_route.note: DuckDuckGoose PR #2 bills the Higgsfield Cloud REST API USD balance (no balance endpoint). The USD cap is the binding constraint there; map per-model API prices into provider_costs.usd_micros.

ep04_line_estimates_usd.L1_refs: <= 1 (stills at <= $0.04; model TBD, needs identity A/B)

gates.name: Never post / upload / hand off
gates.check: No social post, TikTok publish, Grower/Social message, Drive upload or external send unless Travis explicitly ordered that specific action for that file (logged in STATUS with CEST time).
gates.fail_criteria: Any external post/upload/send/handoff without a logged explicit Travis order.

gates.name: QC first
gates.check: Everything shown to Travis (strip, mute, mix) has passed every AUTO gate of its step, with the QC table attached.
gates.fail_criteria: Material reaches Travis with a failing or unrun blocking gate.

gates.name: Balance preflight
gates.check: Read the Higgsfield (or ElevenLabs) balance before a round.
gates.fail_criteria: balance < round_budget + 100, or balance unknown.

gates.name: Budget line stop
gates.check: Track spend per CREDIT-PLAN line and per round.
gates.fail_criteria: Spend reaches 80% of a line/round cap without a stop+report; any spend beyond 100% without Travis; episode total above hard cap.
gates.assist: Travis decides any spend beyond 100% of a line or above the cap

gates.name: Retry caps / surgical regen
gates.check: Count attempts per shot per round; regenerate only failed shot IDs.
gates.fail_criteria: > 2 draft retries in first-pass QC; > 1 paid retry per shot in a revision round; > 3 attempts on a high-risk video; whole-chain regen for a single-shot note.

gates.name: Draft-first / finals only on approval
gates.check: Finals (2k stills, Seedance finalize) are created only for Travis-approved shots; no video before strip approval.
gates.fail_criteria: Any final or video job for a shot without the required approval.

gates.name: Ledger + reconciliation
gates.check: Every job logged with id, model, tier, cost, verdict, used/unused; STATUS has balance before/after; ledger reconciled with the account after timeouts.
gates.fail_criteria: Unlogged job; ledger total != account delta.

gates.name: Reserve draws reported
gates.check: Any move of credits between lines or reserve draw is reported to Travis before spending.
gates.fail_criteria: Reserve spent without a report/approval.
gates.assist: code (default-deny on any reserve draw / line move)

gates.name: Bible + refs loaded
gates.check: Episode folder created; series refs listed in epNN refs/world/media-ids.json (Ep01/Ep02 frames, FAC00-08, desk S01), duck v3 ABs + bare-tuft ABs, logo; media ids valid (re-upload if rejected).
gates.fail_criteria: Any required ref missing or unresolvable.

gates.name: Duck = host/narrator, never a guest
gates.check: Every beat-map row has a duck role in {host, service-side, absent}; duck never in the group, soak, huddle or sitting with guests; stool only at reception.
gates.fail_criteria: Any shot with the duck as a group member/guest or stool outside reception.

items: 1 Duck role per row is one of host / service-side / absent
2 Duck is never inside the guest group, soak, huddle or seated with guests
3 Stool appears only at reception
4 Duck never shares the pool/soak water

gates.name: One resort / STYLE-LOCK plan
gates.check: Every present-day room is mapped to a resort plate/series ref; only flashbacks/pre-resort scenes are exempt.
gates.fail_criteria: A present-day room with no resort source or a new-spa look.

gates.name: NatGeo motion + individuality in templates
gates.check: Every guest prompt template contains gait + carry clause and individual-timing wording.
gates.fail_criteria: Template lacks gait/carry clause or allows upright/hand-carry/synced action.

gates.name: Pick 1 of 3 pitches
gates.check: PITCHES.md with 3 storylines (species, logline, want, climax on real behaviour, duck service role, species fact, set feasibility).
gates.fail_criteria: Fewer than 3 pitches or no Travis pick logged.

gates.name: One-page brief
gates.check: BRIEF.md: logline, duck role, cast table, climax, ending, JP VO outline, rules, open questions with defaults.
gates.fail_criteria: Missing section or > 1 page of core brief.

gates.name: Beat map locked with transitions
gates.check: BEATMAP.md row per shot: length, gen length, model, WET/DRY tag, who+count, duck role, action in/out, trajectory for grabs, transition to next, TOD, props; function-only room words; Travis lock + open questions answered.
gates.fail_criteria: Missing transition/trajectory/model/tag; décor words in room descriptions; no Travis lock.
gates.assist: code (row completeness + décor-word lint) before Travis

gates.name: Ep01 ending template
gates.check: Last scene continues under centred white text logo: 62% width, 2.5 s fade-in, visible last 6.5 s; order gift -> bags on/departure -> ONE small wave/nod -> calm view under logo.
gates.fail_criteria: Separate end plate, plush in the fade, wrong logo spec, long wave, gift after departure.

gates.name: Time-of-day lock
gates.check: TOD per block with sky/light cues and anti-drift lines; written into every prompt.
gates.fail_criteria: Shot without TOD or prompt without sky/light state.

gates.name: Height/scale board
gates.check: Numeric ratio board built locally (duck 1.00x, stool rail at mid-chest, guest cascade); attached or heights stated in prompt.
gates.fail_criteria: No board; ratios missing from multi-character prompts.

gates.name: Per-room continuity sheet
gates.check: CONTINUITY.md: STYLE-LOCK block, room master per room, fixed props with counts, prop chains, costume, wet/dry, duck presence, geography (L/R, launch points).
gates.fail_criteria: Room without master or prop counts; prop chain gaps.

gates.name: Credit plan
gates.check: CREDIT-PLAN.md lines with budget and 80% stop; totals within Ep04 target/cap.
gates.fail_criteria: Plan over cap or lines without stops.

gates.name: New identity refs approved
gates.check: New guest ABs/head sheets/turnarounds, room masters (with _qc vs-world sheet), duck variants pass drift/height check and Travis approval.
gates.fail_criteria: Drafts use a ref that isn't approved or fails resort-match.

gates.name: Character drift gate
gates.check: AB side-by-side crop per character per still (stills/qc/drift/<SHOT>-<char>.jpg); MATCH/DRIFT verdict logged.
gates.fail_criteria: Any DRIFT (crest/tuft colour, texture or size; eyewear; body shape; costume).

items: 1 Crest/tuft colour matches the AB
2 Crest/tuft texture + size match (not only shape)
3 Eyewear/accessories present and identical
4 Body shape/proportions match
5 Costume items present (hats, glasses, bundle) per CONTINUITY
rubric.pass_rule: all items pass on every character; any fail = DRIFT

gates.name: Duck identity gate (§13)
gates.check: Duck crop vs v3 AB02/AB03 (+ bare-tuft AB02 when bare).
gates.fail_criteria: Long/wedge/realistic bill; flat wild-mallard head; white neck ring; slim body or long neck; tuque/vest mismatch; tuft not 3-lobe ~1/4 head height; duck < ~12% frame height when acting; missing reception stool.
gates.assist: code (duck count, height fraction >= 0.12, stool at reception)

gates.name: Headcount
gates.check: Count characters vs beat map.
gates.fail_criteria: Extra or missing character; second duck; phantom.

gates.name: Height/scale
gates.check: Measure ratios vs board.
gates.fail_criteria: > 10% off; size morph between shots.

gates.name: STYLE-LOCK / background drift (still)
gates.check: Side-by-side vs series refs; banned list; >= 2 series signatures (dome glazing, curved warm wood, LED strip, ring light, glass balustrade, round fire pit).
gates.fail_criteria: Any banned element (noren, glyphs, paper/stone/iron onsen lanterns, niwaki, boulder rims, stepping stones, bamboo, tatami, zabuton, shoji, ryokan panelling, arch tunnels, irori, tetsubin, celadon, lacquer, key paddles); < 2 signatures; reads as another spa. Exempt: flashback/pre-resort shots.

items: 1 No banned element (list in fail_criteria) anywhere in frame
2 >= 2 series signatures visible (dome glazing, curved warm wood, LED strip, ring light, glass balustrade, round fire pit)
3 Materials/palette read as the same Mid-Mountain resort as the refs, not a ryokan/bathhouse/other spa
4 Room geometry matches its room master
5 Lighting is consistent with the TOD lock
rubric.pass_rule: items 1-3 must pass; 4-5 fail -> WATCH with crop. Flashback/pre-resort shots exempt.

gates.name: Props and counts
gates.check: Compare to continuity sheet.
gates.fail_criteria: Prop added/lost/moved; wrong count; story prop early (e.g. key on desk before hand-off); wrong luggage.

gates.name: Side / screen-direction continuity
gates.check: LEFT/RIGHT of each character vs neighbouring shots.
gates.fail_criteria: Unmotivated side swap across a cut.

gates.name: NatGeo pose
gates.check: Gait/carry/hold check.
gates.fail_criteria: Upright stance; human-style carry/hold while moving; hand-held cup; synced group pose.

items: 1 Quadrupedal or natural species stance (no upright human stance)
2 Nothing carried in hands/forepaws while moving; mouth/back carry only
3 No hand-held cup or human-style grip
4 Group poses not synchronised (individual timing/pose)

gates.name: Treadmill rule (staging)
gates.check: Runs drafted as START + END frames, same locked camera, opposite sides.
gates.fail_criteria: Single-frame run; planned travel < 40% frame width.

gates.name: Leap / hand-off path
gates.check: Launch -> contact -> landing as 3 frames from the same camera; contact on the arc; depth plausible.
gates.fail_criteria: Contact off path; object behind the duck; mid-action start frame.

gates.name: Edit-order stills strip approval
gates.check: Strip of every still in edit order with beat text, duck role, TOD, per-cut transition notes, QC verdicts, open notes.
gates.fail_criteria: No strip, or video started before Travis approval.

gates.name: Wet / water realism (still)
gates.check: Wet props heavy/dark/matted/sagging; refraction, caustics, ripples, steam; wet fur; underwater particles + blue falloff.
gates.fail_criteria: Dry-balloon wet props; glassy CGI water; no depth.

items: 1 Wet props read heavy: dark, matted, sagging (not dry balloons)
2 Water shows refraction and/or caustics and ripples
3 Steam present where the water is hot
4 Wet fur/feathers clump and darken
5 Underwater: particles + blue depth falloff
6 Water is not glassy/CGI-smooth

gates.name: TOD match
gates.check: Sky/light vs TOD lock.
gates.fail_criteria: Wrong TOD block.

gates.name: Final-res check
gates.check: 2k final matches approved draft 1:1; textures; small props legible; clean faces; no garbled text.
gates.fail_criteria: Any composition/prop difference; illegible story prop; melted features.

items: 1 Composition matches the approved draft 1:1 (same framing, positions, counts)
2 Small story props legible
3 Faces/eyes clean, no melted features
4 No garbled text/glyphs
5 Textures at 2k detail
rubric.precheck: code: SSIM of a 512-px downscale vs the approved draft; flag < 0.6 for the judge (uncalibrated; log values on Ep04)
refs: approved draft of the same shot

gates.assist: code (SSIM pre-check vs approved draft; uncalibrated)

gates.name: Model routing
gates.check: WET/MUD/POOL/SOAK/UNDERWATER/splash -> Kling 3.0 pro (sound off, 1.5 cr/s); dry identity-critical/hand-off -> Seedance 2.5 480p draft then finalize/upscale, always with declined_preset_id 24bae836-2c4a-48e0-89b6-49fcc0b21612.
gates.fail_criteria: Wet shot sent to Seedance; Seedance job without declined_preset_id; >1 rephrase on a blocked dry Seedance job before switching to Kling.

gates.name: First/mid/last frame gate
gates.check: Frame 0/mid/end sheet (+ full-fps for high-risk); first frame matches start still.
gates.fail_criteria: Doesn't start on the still; headcount change; prop appears/vanishes; morph; hidden cut/teleport.

gates.name: Duck identity gate in motion (§13)
gates.check: Duck crop at first/mid/last vs AB02/AB03 (+ bare-tuft AB).
gates.fail_criteria: Any §13 failure at any of the three frames.

thresholds.frames: 0, duration/2, last decoded; plus in/mid/out of the used window if picks trims; every 0.5 s for high-risk clips

rubric.see: G4.02 scoring applied at first/mid/last (+ used-window frames)

gates.assist: code (duck count, height fraction, frame sampling)

gates.name: Background drift / no timelapse sky
gates.check: bgdrift.py on first/mid/last (sky band top 30%, side bands 12%) + eyeball top third t0 vs tend.
gates.fail_criteria: DRIFT (sky >= 14 or sides >= 18) not explained by subject or scripted camera move; new background features; timelapse clouds.

items: 1 Drift is localised where the subject moves (body/splash/steam), or the scripted camera move explains it (push-in raises side drift evenly)
2 Sky band shows no cloud travel / timelapse between t0 and tend
3 No new background feature appears (waterfall, dome, building)
4 Fixed geometry (rails, domes, roofline) keeps its shape
rubric.pass_rule: DRIFT/watch passes only if 1 and 2-4 all pass; otherwise FAIL
refs: Ep03 O03-v2: sides 12.3 watch explained by push-in -> PASS (ep03-snow-monkeys/clips/step9/qc/)

gates.assist: judge (is a DRIFT/watch explained by subject motion or the scripted camera move? rubric)

gates.name: NatGeo motion
gates.check: Gait/carry/hold/individual timing over the used window.
gates.fail_criteria: Bipedal walk/stand inside the used window; synced motion; cartoon motion.

items: 1 No bipedal walk/stand inside the used window
2 Gait species-correct on all fours
3 Individual timing, no synced motion
4 No cartoon motion
rubric.pass_rule: all items pass inside the used window

gates.name: No Ken Burns / no stiffness / no static fills
gates.check: Per-clip frame-motion metric over the used window (stillgate thresholds, see G4.10) + freezedetect; vgate local p90 as a stiffness hint; no pan/zoom over stills; blocked shots rerouted, not filled.
gates.fail_criteria: peak_fd < 3.0 AND mean_fd < 0.15 over the used window (still-only); Ken Burns; frozen bodies (local p90 far below neighbours, e.g. 1.3 vs 6-16, judged on WATCH); static hold used as a fill.

thresholds.stiffness_hint: vgate local_p90 far below neighbours (Ep03 A04 v1: 1.3 vs 6-16) -> WATCH, judge
thresholds.note: per-clip version of G4.10 over the used window

gates.name: Treadmill rule (motion)
gates.check: Runner screen position across the clip.
gates.fail_criteria: < 40% frame-width travel and no background parallax.

gates.name: Spatial logic
gates.check: Launch point = last seen position; path on arc.
gates.fail_criteria: Character relocates to a new launch point; teleport between shots.

gates.name: Wet realism in motion
gates.check: Water depth/refraction; heavy wet props; no standing in deep water.
gates.fail_criteria: Glassy water; dry-balloon props; character stands in deep water in the used window.

items: 1 Water keeps depth/refraction over the clip
2 Wet props stay heavy (no floating dry balloon)
3 No character stands up in deep water inside the used window
4 Ripples/splashes react to motion
5 Not glassy
rubric.pass_rule: all items pass in the used window

gates.name: Edge extras
gates.check: Full-fps check of frame edges and doorways.
gates.fail_criteria: Any invented character (phantom animal, real mallard walking in).

gates.name: Per-cut QC
gates.check: Last frame A vs first frame B for every cut: props/counts, holder, costume, wet/dry, TOD, geometry, LEFT/RIGHT, headcount; hand-offs one at a time. Table in STATUS.
gates.fail_criteria: Any unexplained continuity break at a cut.

gates.name: Duck contact sheet
gates.check: One crop per duck shot next to the AB, built per mute.
gates.fail_criteria: Any major drift (fix before delivery); minor drift not reported with crops.

signs: b head flat wild-mallard or sleek, long neck
e too small to read (code measures; < 0.12 frame height when acting)
plus: apparel: cream tuque with pom-pom, cream->olive vest (T shots)
scoring.score: 0 on-model / 1 minor / 2 drift per sign, with confidence and one-line evidence

rubric.major: any sign = 2, OR neck ring at confidence >= 0.5, OR apparel/tuft mismatch, OR sum of minors >= 3 across the frame set -> regenerate before delivery
rubric.pass_rule: no major in the mute; every minor listed with crops

gates.name: STYLE-LOCK audit
gates.check: One mid-frame per shot vs series refs; list pre-style-lock shots still in the timeline.
gates.fail_criteria: Banned element or pre-style-lock shot left without a redo plan.

gates.name: Technical mute check
gates.check: freezedetect n=0.0008 d=0.5 none; blackdetect none; no audio stream; 1080x1920 24 fps; dissolves + logo frames checked. Runtime 113-125 s.
gates.fail_criteria: Any detection or wrong format.

gates.name: Flashback treatment
gates.check: Memory/past graded warm faded film (lifted blacks, lower contrast, warm, ~0.7 sat, soft blur, vignette, grain); colour returns through the dissolve.
gates.fail_criteria: Flashback ungraded or present-day graded.

gates.name: Cut-for-story review
gates.check: Flag shots that read inconsistently (humanoid-looking tiny animals, wrong duck, ghosts) or don't move the story; propose cuts; re-check neighbouring cuts and VO references.
gates.fail_criteria: Known-inconsistent shot left in without flag; cut leaves a dangling reference.

flag_triggers: tiny animals that read humanoid (Ep03 A01 drone)
set-up whose pay-off reads alone (Ep03 C03/C04)
rubric.note: human gate: harness proposes, Travis decides

gates.name: Review copy <= 30 MB
gates.check: 720x1280 2-pass x264 ~1.7 Mb/s + 2 fps sheet.
gates.fail_criteria: Size > 30 MB or duration mismatch.

gates.name: Travis mute review
gates.check: Travis notes logged verbatim with CEST time; fixes surgical; re-QC.
gates.fail_criteria: Notes not logged or fixed without re-QC.

gates.name: Picture lock
gates.check: Travis picture-locks the mute; after lock no picture change without Travis reopening (new version).
gates.fail_criteria: Audio work before lock; picture altered after lock.

gates.name: No still-only shots (frame-motion gate)
gates.check: Per-shot consecutive-frame |diff| on every mute AND on every final picture (re-run on the nosubs master before G6.09 and on the delivery file at G7.01). Decode at 180x320 grey; shot boundaries from the stitch manifest/EDL; dissolve overlaps excluded. mean_fd = mean |diff| (0-255); peak_fd = median over frames of the 99.5th-percentile |diff|. Writes <mute>-stillgate.json next to the QC artifacts.
gates.fail_criteria: FAIL (still-only): peak_fd < 3.0 AND mean_fd < 0.15 -> route the shot back to Step 3 (re-animate from the SAME approved still at the SAME duration, prompt names continuous ambient motion; never 'nothing else moves'). WATCH: peak_fd < 6.0 OR mean_fd < 0.25 -> judge on a frame sheet; PASS only if real motion is visible.
gates.when: every mute + every final picture (Travis rule 2026-10-04 22:21 CEST)

thresholds.peak_stat: median over frames of per-frame p99.5 |diff|
thresholds.exclude: dissolve overlap frames + 1 frame at each boundary

F04.verdict: WATCH -> pass (one wave then calm end take)

calibration.test: the known still (Ep03 mute v5 O03) must FAIL; mute v6 must have no FAIL

gates.name: Script lock: Travis approves the placed script before any audio
gates.check: VO-SCRIPT.md (JP + EN, per shot, in/out on locked picture) + timing JSON + draft SRT exist, AND Travis approval is logged in STATUS with CEST time. Conditional approvals ("OK if timing checks out"): the condition is checked by code and the result logged before any generation.
gates.fail_criteria: Any ElevenLabs VO/music/SFX credit spent before the logged approval, or with an unchecked condition; script files missing.

gates.name: VO style checklist
gates.check: JP prose, no rhymes, ぼく/です・ます; opens きょうのお客様は; cute lines over action; one species fact; climax lines in gaps (>= 0.3 s after hit, >= 0.4 s before next); no VO in cold open/flashback or logo fade-in; callback きょうも、いいご滞在でした… in farewell slot; sign-off ぼくはクアックド・コンシェルジュ。またあした。 under the logo; ~4.2 mora/s; >= 0.4 s between lines; every line matches on-screen action.
gates.fail_criteria: Any checklist item missing or violated.
gates.assist: code (gap/timing asserts, protected windows, mora rate)

gates.name: VO voice settings
gates.check: ElevenLabs Sora 4sirbXwrtRlmPV80MJkQ, eleven_v3, [softly] [gently] [warm smile], atempo 0.90, peaks -2 dBFS; every line ASR-checked; pickups RMS-matched.
gates.fail_criteria: Other voice/model/tags; unchecked line; pickup level mismatch > 1 dB.

gates.name: Music approach
gates.check: ElevenLabs Music, instrumental Ghibli-style chamber score shaped to beats; ONE take by default; automation for beats; VO duck -4 dB (climax -7), floor -9, never gated; cadence resolves under the logo.
gates.fail_criteria: Second take without Travis OK; lyrical/English vocals; gated dropouts.
gates.assist: judge (instrumental, no lyrics/English vocals, cadence under the logo)

gates.name: SFX / species sounds / water
gates.check: Real species vocalisations; duck sounds sparing; each water shot has its own layered distinct real water sound; no loops; beds ducked -3 dB (-5 climax); de-buzzed.
gates.fail_criteria: Generic/looped water bed; missing species sounds on key beats; duck sound under the end watermark other than sign-off.

items: 1 Each water shot has its own distinct layered real water sound (no shared bed across shots)
2 No audible loop/repeat within a shot (autocorrelation pre-check flags period < shot length)
3 Key beats carry real species vocalisations
4 Duck sounds sparing; nothing under the end watermark but the sign-off
5 No 50 Hz buzz
rubric.precheck: code: cue table one water cue per wet shot; loop autocorrelation

gates.assist: judge (water distinct per shot, no loop; rubric)

gates.name: Tagger sanity
gates.check: PANNs tags judged on stem + full mix with window-edge awareness.
gates.fail_criteria: Take accepted/rejected on a solo short-window tag alone; human-like animal take kept.

gates.name: Builder asserts
gates.check: No VO in protected windows; climax lines start >= 0.3 s after a hit ends and end >= 0.4 s before the next hit; line gap >= 0.4 s; last line ends <= T-0.3 s; subs = VO +/- 5 ms.
gates.fail_criteria: Any assert fails.

gates.name: Loudness = Ep02
gates.check: ebur128 on the master and on every AAC copy (review, delivery): integrated -12.5 +/- 0.5 LUFS, LRA ~7-9 LU, TP <= -0.3 dBTP; limiter alimiter 0.86 level=disabled.
gates.fail_criteria: Integrated outside -12.5 +/- 0.5 LUFS; true peak > -0.3 dBTP on master or review copy.

gates.name: Picture untouched
gates.check: No-subs video stream MD5 equals locked mute.
gates.fail_criteria: MD5 mismatch.

gates.name: Cream EN subs
gates.check: ASS WarmVacation: Comfortaa 58, &H00E8F8FF, outline &H002A3A5C 5, shadow 2, MarginV 240, PlayRes 1080x1920; max 2 lines; SRT too.
gates.fail_criteria: Different style/colour; > 2 lines; auto captions.

gates.name: Outputs + QC doc
gates.check: final mp4 (subs), nosubs, review <= 30 MB, stems, subs, cues JSON, audio ledger, QC md with loudness vs Ep02 and open points.
gates.fail_criteria: Any output missing.

gates.name: Travis mix approval / episode lock
gates.check: Travis approves or locks; notes -> pickups only, reuse stems.
gates.fail_criteria: Delivery before lock.

gates.name: Drive copy encode
gates.check: 1080x1920 2-pass x264 (~3.0-3.1 Mb/s) + AAC 160-192k encoded from the mix WAV (never AAC->AAC); size < 50 MB (aim <= 48); true peak <= -0.3 dBTP; G4.10 re-run on the file.
gates.fail_criteria: Size >= 50 MB; TP over; duration mismatch.

thresholds.audio_source: encode from the mix WAV, never AAC->AAC (Ep03 22:09 copy hit 0.0 dBTP)

gates.name: Drive upload (only on order)
gates.check: Upload to folder 1dCbQN4dYL8fl4Nn4uOmaAaqa5R_BLdnd as 'EpNN - <Title> (final).mp4' only when Travis orders it; link logged.
gates.fail_criteria: Upload without explicit order; wrong folder/name.

gates.name: Grower handoff (never post)
gates.check: Package (final, nosubs, review, title, JP/EN logline, @thequackedconcierge, Travis-set priority) prepared; sent only on Travis go; nobody posts without the lock.
gates.fail_criteria: Handoff sent without Travis go; any post.

gates.name: Lock record + lessons
gates.check: LOCKED block in STATUS (files, CEST time, never posted); CREDIT-PLAN closed; lessons appended to PIPELINE-LESSONS + handbook.
gates.fail_criteria: Missing lock record or credit close-out.

changelog: 1.1 (2026-10-04 CEST): check_type code|judge|human on every gate (+assist); G4.10 no-still-only-shots frame-motion gate (Travis 22:21); G5.03 merged into G5.01; numeric thresholds added (G1.03/04, G3.01/03/06, G4.04/05/07, G6.01-03/05/06/08, G7.01, GC.02); judge rubrics + judge_policy; Higgsfield L5 60->0 (lines sum 1,000); units, ElevenLabs stop_fraction, unit prices, USD view; BARE retired as routing tag.

judge_policy.verdict: keep the worse of the two runs
judge_policy.on_escalate: fail closed -> human (Travis sees the crop)
judge_policy.output: JSON per rubric item: pass|fail, confidence, one-line evidence
